text.zh-CN:
高血压是血液长期以过高压力冲击血管，常在没有不适时损伤心、脑、肾。

- 上面的收缩压是心脏收缩时的压力，下面的舒张压是心脏放松时的压力。
- 头痛不能用来判断血压高低；多数人需要测量才知道有高血压。
- 治疗关注长期器官保护，感觉正常也不能自行停药。
text.en:
Hypertension means blood persistently pushes against artery walls at excessive pressure, often silently harming the heart, brain and kidneys.

- Systolic pressure is measured when the heart contracts; diastolic pressure when it relaxes.
- Headache cannot reliably identify high blood pressure; most people need measurements to know.
- Treatment protects organs over time, so feeling well is not a reason to stop medicines.

text.zh-CN:
高血压通常由多种因素共同形成。

- 年龄和家族遗传无法改变，但不代表一定会发病。
- 盐多、体重超标、缺乏活动和饮酒过量会增加风险，可逐步改善。
- 肾脏病、糖尿病等会影响总体风险，评估时要一起告诉医生。
text.en:
Several factors usually contribute to hypertension.

- Age and family history cannot be changed, but do not make disease inevitable.
- Excess salt, excess weight, inactivity and heavy drinking increase risk and can be addressed gradually.
- Kidney disease and diabetes affect overall risk and should be discussed during assessment.

text.zh-CN:
出现器官受损的症状时，先急救，不要等血压自行下降。

- 持续胸部压痛伴出汗或气短，立即呼叫当地急救，勿自行开车。
- 突然说话不清、单侧肢体无力或视力异常，同样需立即急救。
- WHO指出约180/120毫米汞柱或更高并伴严重头痛、胸痛、气促、意识异常时应立即求医；较低读数也不能排除急症。
text.en:
Possible organ injury needs emergency action, not waiting for readings to fall.

- Call local emergency services for persistent chest pressure with sweating or breathlessness; do not drive yourself.
- Sudden speech problems, one-sided weakness or visual disturbance also need emergency assessment.
- WHO identifies readings around 180/120 mmHg or higher with severe headache, chest pain, breathlessness or confusion as requiring immediate care; lower readings do not exclude emergencies.

text.zh-CN:
就诊安排取决于读数和症状，不能只看一个数字。

- 多次偏高但没有急症表现，预约基层或心内科并带上家庭记录。
- 极高读数即使无不适也应及时联系医疗人员，获得当日处理建议。
- 已有方案者按约复诊；反复头晕、乏力或新出现不适，要提前咨询而非自行增减药。
text.en:
Care depends on both readings and symptoms, not one number.

- Repeated high readings without emergency symptoms warrant an appointment with home records.
- Very high readings even without symptoms need prompt contact with a clinician for same-day advice.
- Attend planned reviews; recurrent dizziness, weakness or new symptoms merit earlier advice rather than changing tablets yourself.

text.zh-CN:
诊断需要规范、重复测量。

- 袖带测量受姿势、紧张和活动影响，单次偏高不足以确认长期高血压。
- 家庭多日记录或24小时动态监测可以了解离开诊室后的血压。
- NHS采用诊室140/90、家庭135/85毫米汞柱作为常用判断门槛；各地区标准和个人治疗目标不完全相同。
text.en:
Diagnosis requires repeated, properly performed measurements.

- Posture, anxiety and recent activity affect cuff readings, so one high result cannot establish persistent hypertension.
- Several days of home readings or a 24-hour monitor show pressure outside the clinic.
- NHS commonly uses clinic 140/90 and home 135/85 mmHg thresholds; regional definitions and individual treatment targets differ.

text.zh-CN:
需要分清真实持续升高与暂时变化。

- 诊室紧张时高、回家后正常，可能存在白大衣效应，需家庭或动态记录帮助确认。
- 袖带不合适或测量方式不规范会影响结果，应先核对方法。
- 糖尿病、肾脏病等需要同时评估，不能把所有头痛和头晕都归因于高血压。
text.en:
Distinguish persistent hypertension from temporary changes.

- Clinic-only elevation may reflect a white-coat effect; home or ambulatory measurements help clarify it.
- An unsuitable cuff or poor technique can distort results, so check the method.
- Assess diabetes and kidney disease alongside blood pressure; do not assume every headache or dizzy spell is caused by hypertension.

text.zh-CN:
治疗既降低读数，也减少未来卒中和心脏病风险。

- 减盐、活动和体重管理是长期基础，即使已经服药也有价值。
- 血压明显升高或总体风险较高时，医生可能建议立即加药，不必等待生活调整失败。
- 一种药不够时可能联合数种；目标需结合年龄、其他疾病和耐受程度商定。
text.en:
Treatment reduces both pressure and future stroke or heart disease risk.

- Less salt, activity and weight management remain useful even when taking medicines.
- Marked elevation or higher overall risk may justify medicines without waiting for lifestyle measures alone.
- Several drugs may be needed; agree a target that considers age, other illnesses and tolerability.

text.zh-CN:
不同降压药作用与风险不同，选药后还要监测耐受和相关化验。

- ACEI是血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂，ARB是血管紧张素受体阻滞剂，都是干预使血管收缩的信号以降低压力；如赖诺普利和氯沙坦。
- ACEI可引起持续干咳，ACEI/ARB用药期间需按安排检查肾功能；嘴唇、舌头或咽喉肿胀并呼吸困难应立即急救。备孕或怀孕需及时核对替代药。
- 氨氯地平等钙通道阻滞剂使血管放松，常见踝部肿胀、头痛或头晕；持续不适需联系医生，不自行停药。
- 吲达帕胺等利尿剂增加盐和水排出，可能引起脱水及血盐变化。明显口渴、尿少、肌无力或心跳异常要咨询医生；按安排复查肾功能和血液盐分。
text.en:
Antihypertensive classes differ in actions and risks, so treatment includes tolerability and laboratory monitoring.

- ACE inhibitors (angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors) and ARBs (angiotensin receptor blockers) interrupt signals that narrow vessels; examples include lisinopril and losartan.
- ACE inhibitors can cause persistent dry cough. Kidney checks are needed during ACE-inhibitor or ARB treatment. Swollen lips, tongue or throat with breathing difficulty needs emergency help; pregnancy planning or pregnancy requires prompt medicine review.
- Calcium-channel blockers such as amlodipine relax vessels but commonly cause ankle swelling, headache or dizziness. Report persistent problems instead of stopping treatment yourself.
- Diuretics such as indapamide increase salt and water loss and can cause dehydration or blood-salt changes. Seek advice for marked thirst, reduced urine, muscle weakness or irregular heartbeat; attend kidney-function and electrolyte checks.

text.zh-CN:
饮食重点是持续减少盐和改善整体结构。

- 少用盐、酱油及高盐调味料，留意腌制品和加工食品里的隐形盐。
- 用蔬菜、水果、全谷物等替换部分高脂高盐食物，避免只依赖一种所谓降压食品。
- 减少过量饮酒；合并肾病者的水果、补充剂和饮食限制应另行确认。
text.en:
Diet aims at sustained salt reduction and better overall balance.

- Use less salt and salty sauces, and notice hidden salt in preserved and processed foods.
- Replace some salty, fatty foods with vegetables, fruit and whole grains instead of relying on a single blood-pressure food.
- Reduce excessive alcohol; people with kidney disease need separate advice about food and supplements.

text.zh-CN:
把测量和服药变成可持续的日常习惯。

- 请医疗人员演示家用血压计的用法，按约定时段记录读数和不适。
- 用提醒或药盒帮助规律服药，漏服如何处理向药师确认，不自行加倍。
- 在可耐受范围逐渐增加步行等活动，出现胸痛或明显气促时停止活动并求助。
text.en:
Build sustainable measurement and treatment habits.

- Ask a professional to demonstrate your monitor and record readings and symptoms at agreed times.
- Use reminders or a pill organizer; ask a pharmacist about missed tablets instead of doubling them yourself.
- Increase activities such as walking gradually; stop and seek help for chest pain or marked breathlessness.

text.zh-CN:
其他健康问题会改变控制目标和方案。

- 有糖尿病、肾病、既往卒中或心脏病者，医生可能设定更严格目标并安排相关检查。
- 老年人若治疗后站起时头晕，应报告以评估跌倒风险和用药耐受。
- 备孕或怀孕时必须告知医生，由产科和开药医生核对当前药物是否适用。
text.en:
Other health conditions change treatment targets and choices.

- Diabetes, kidney disease or previous stroke or heart disease may lead to tighter targets and additional assessment.
- Older adults should report dizziness on standing so treatment tolerance and fall risk can be reviewed.
- Tell the prescriber if planning pregnancy or pregnant so maternity and prescribing teams can check medicine suitability.

text.zh-CN:
高血压常需要长期管理，控制良好不等于已经消失。

- 随访查看家庭读数、服药情况和不良反应，再决定是否调整方案。
- 医生按用药和合并疾病安排相关化验；不要只盯血压忽略其他风险。
- 持续控制可降低心、脑、肾损伤风险。
text.en:
Hypertension often needs lifelong management; control does not necessarily mean cure.

- Reviews consider home readings, adherence and adverse effects before changing treatment.
- Laboratory follow-up depends on drugs and other illnesses; do not focus only on the pressure number.
- Sustained control lowers the risk of heart, brain and kidney damage.

text.zh-CN:
长期压力过高会损伤血管和器官，不是每个人都会发生全部问题。

- 脑部血管堵塞或破裂可造成卒中，出现突然无力或说话不清要急救。
- 心脏负担增加可导致心衰，冠脉供血受影响可出现心绞痛或心肌梗死。
- 肾脏和眼部血管也可能受损，因此即使无症状仍需管理。
text.en:
Sustained high pressure damages vessels and organs, but not everyone develops every complication.

- Blocked or ruptured brain vessels can cause stroke; sudden weakness or speech difficulty needs emergency help.
- Extra heart strain can cause heart failure, while reduced coronary blood supply can cause angina or heart attack.
- Kidney and eye vessels may also be damaged, making management important even without symptoms.

text.zh-CN:
预防包括减少发生机会、及早发现和避免恶化。

- 保持适合自身的体重、规律活动、少盐并戒烟，可降低总体心血管风险。
- 因为早期通常无症状，应按年龄和个人风险安排测压，而不是等到头痛。
- 已经确诊者坚持治疗和复诊；有家族史也可从生活方式管理获益。
text.en:
Prevention includes lowering risk, detecting disease and preventing deterioration.

- A suitable weight, regular activity, less salt and no tobacco reduce overall cardiovascular risk.
- Because early disease is usually silent, arrange checks based on age and risk rather than waiting for headache.
- After diagnosis, continue treatment and reviews; healthy habits still help when there is a family history.

limitations.en: Expanded educational draft based on inspected official patient-information sections. Independent claim verification, regional applicability review and clinical sign-off remain pending; this is not an individual diagnosis or prescription.
